Package eu.algites.lib.storage.object

Interface AIiObjectStorageStronglyConsistentBackend

All Superinterfaces:
AIiObjectStorage, AIiObjectStorageConditionalUpdater, AIiObjectStorageCreateOnlyWriter, AIiObjectStorageReader
public interface AIiObjectStorageStronglyConsistentBackend extends AIiObjectStorageReader, AIiObjectStorageCreateOnlyWriter, AIiObjectStorageConditionalUpdater
Strong per-key read/conditional-write backend suitable as a primitive for durable release-ledger control records, subject to further application-level fencing, audit and authorization rules.

Every key operation is linearizable across all independent clients using this physical namespace. Successful create/CAS acknowledgements are visible to subsequent HEAD and GET calls; revision tokens uniquely identify stored generations and never permit ABA acceptance after delete/recreate. The implementation must establish these properties with the real backend, not with a process-local lock or a client-side check-then-PUT.

This interface does NOT promise atomic transactions across multiple keys, lease enforcement, distributed fencing, or remote publication idempotency.
